mapper.select: SELECT USER_ID AS userId, USER_GENDER AS userGender, USER_HEIGHT AS userHeight, USER_WEIGHT AS userWeight, USER_BODYFAT AS userBodyfat, USER_MUSCLE AS userMuscle, USER_GOAL AS userGoal FROM TB_USER_INFO WHERE USER_ID = #{userId}
mapper.update: MERGE INTO TB_USER_INFO T_INFO USING (SELECT #{userId} AS USER_ID FROM DUAL) T_USER ON (T_INFO.USER_ID = T_USER.USER_ID) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET USER_GENDER = #{userGender}, USER_HEIGHT = #{userHeight}, USER_WEIGHT = #{userWeight}, USER_BODYFAT = #{userBodyfat}, USER_MUSCLE = #{userMuscle}, USER_GOAL = #{userGoal}, UPDATED_DATE = SYSDATE, UPDATED_ID = #{userId} WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT ( USER_ID, USER_GENDER, USER_HEIGHT, USER_WEIGHT, USER_BODYFAT, USER_MUSCLE, USER_GOAL, CREATED_ID, UPDATED_ID ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{userGender}, #{userHeight}, #{userWeight}, #{userBodyfat}, #{userMuscle}, #{userGoal}, #{userId}, #{userId} )
